name: proSapient
description: proSapient is a London-headquartered expert network founded in 2017. It combines client services teams with an AI-enabled platform for expert calls, surveys, transcripts and AI-moderated interviews, serving consulting firms, investors and corporations.
keyDifferentiators: proSapient says SearchAI can search internal expert databases and transcript libraries.
The company advertises free transcripts, typically within four hours, with claimed 99% accuracy.
AIMI is offered as managed research or expert recruitment for clients using other AI-interview platforms.
bestFor: Consulting firms seeking expert calls and surveys
Private equity teams conducting due diligence
Teams combining human-led and AI-moderated expert interviews

compliance.mnpiPolicy: For AIMI engagements, proSapient says experts complete training covering MNPI, confidentiality and conflicts before engagement.
compliance.expertVetting: The company describes expert screening, identity and work-experience verification, and human oversight for AIMI projects.

overview:
proSapient was founded in 2017 by Margo Polishchuk and Jordan Shlosberg. Its website lists London as headquarters, with offices in Raleigh, Toronto and Lisbon. Aneil Rakity is listed as CEO and Polishchuk as Co-Founder and President.

The business combines client services with technology rather than offering only self-service sourcing. Its 2025 group accounts, filed in September 2026, report turnover of £41.13 million, up 24% from £33.05 million in 2024, and a £1.27 million profit compared with a £0.64 million loss in 2024. Average employment was 274 in 2025.

In an April 2026 article, proSapient described its work on AI-moderated interviews and supplying respondents to Strella, Listen Labs and Outset. Its current AIMI offering includes both managed projects and panel recruitment for other platforms.

history.narrative: proSapient was co-founded in 2017 by Margo Polishchuk, who had worked in expert networking, and Jordan Shlosberg, formerly a client. Smedvig Capital announced its $10 million Series A investment on 18 January 2021, alongside Guy Hands and existing investor 24 Haymarket.

timeline.event: Founded by Margo Polishchuk and Jordan Shlosberg.
Smedvig Capital announces a $10 million Series A on 18 January, with Guy Hands and 24 Haymarket participating.
On 21 April, proSapient publishes an article on AI-moderated interviews and its respondent-supply partnerships.
Group accounts filed on 29 September report 2025 turnover of £41.13 million and profit of £1.27 million.
The registered office moves to 6 Devonshire Square, London, on 21 September, according to Companies House.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Consultations
servicesDetailed.description: Clients connect with industry experts through live calls. The platform supports Zoom, browser and telephone access, scheduling and follow-up messaging, according to proSapient.

servicesDetailed.name: Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: proSapient offers B2B and B2C research through online panels, telephone interviews and AI-moderated research. The company says it provides programming support or recruits participants into a client’s existing survey tool; its Survey Builder includes GenAI integrations.

servicesDetailed.name: Transcripts
servicesDetailed.description: proSapient advertises free AI-generated transcripts reviewed by humans, claiming 99% accuracy and typical delivery within four hours. It offers AI summaries and translations into 48 languages; human-reviewed translations cost extra. The company says compliance-approved transcripts can be added to a searchable, shareable library.

servicesDetailed.name: Long-term Engagements
servicesDetailed.description: The company offers deal advisors, embedded project specialists and recurring research panels. Experts can work directly with the client after a fixed release fee, paid from an existing bundle or invoiced separately; exclusive arrangements are available.

servicesDetailed.name: AI-moderated Interviews (AIMI)
servicesDetailed.description: proSapient says it can recruit and screen experts, manage AI-led interviews and deliver transcripts and synthesized findings. Alternatively, it supplies expert participants for clients using their own AI-interview tools.

servicesDetailed.name: Platform and Messaging
servicesDetailed.description: The company describes an expert dashboard, calendar integration, automated scheduling, AI transcript summaries and direct expert messaging for follow-ups and document sharing.

aiPlatform.narrative: proSapient describes SearchAI as a machine-learning system that interprets semantic and contextual relationships in search queries. Its associates select experts and provide feedback to the model. Its website also describes AI-supported scheduling, transcription, survey programming and interview moderation; performance claims are company-stated.
features: SearchAI expert recommendations and entity analysis
Search of internal expert databases and transcript libraries
AI scheduling assistant with work and team calendar synchronization
AIMI interviews with dynamic follow-up questions

complianceExtended.narrative: proSapient says it tailors compliance rules to client requirements, screens experts and uses automated SearchAI compliance checks and monitoring. Its AIMI page describes expert training on MNPI, confidentiality, conflicts and truthful representation, plus human screening and authentication. These are descriptions of company procedures, not an independent assessment of their effectiveness.
highlights: Company-described client-specific compliance rules and adherence reporting
Company-described expert and associate compliance training
AIMI experts agree to terms and complete training before engagement
AIMI expert responses must not be generated or assisted by AI, according to proSapient
Company states that expert personal data is protected in accordance with GDPR

clientFit.narrative: Editorial assessment: the documented services make proSapient relevant to consulting and investment teams combining expert calls, surveys and ongoing advisor access. Its managed AIMI option may also suit teams seeking outsourced interview operations.
segments: Teams sourcing experts for AI-moderated interviews

strengths: Company-described integration of search, scheduling, transcripts and messaging
Choice of live expert calls and managed AI-moderated interviews
Survey programming support or recruitment into external survey tools
caveats: Transcript accuracy and delivery figures are company claims, not independently tested benchmarks.
The sources reviewed do not substantiate the previous 50,000+ expert count or a current standardized per-call price. Buyers should request project-specific coverage and commercial terms.
SearchAI documentation describes associates selecting experts; buyers seeking a wholly self-serve workflow should confirm access and responsibilities.
notableFacts: A $10 million Series A was announced by Smedvig Capital in January 2021.
The 2025 group accounts report average employment of 274.
The company’s About page lists Peter Davio as Chief Technology Officer.
Companies House records a London registered-office change in September 2026.
